correctness.rationale: The exact graph normal form, unique/absent extra-cross-edge perfect matching (depending on parity), independent two-cone open-ladder suspension recurrence, and literal path-independence attaching subcomplex give a complete uniform homotopy proof for all n>=2. value.rationale: This is a complete infinite-family classification of a natural one-edge defect of a canonical cubic graph: removing a perimeter edge eliminates one sphere per even width and generates a periodic odd-width contractibility phenomenon. It distinguishes the two edge orbits of Möbius ladders and contrasts the untwisted cyclic prism; the path-independence attachment gives a reusable combinatorial mechanism. No downstream paper-sized theorem is required.
